# Poker glossary (English ↔ 中文)

*The words you’ll hear at a home game, with plain-English meanings and the terms Chinese-speaking players use.*

8 min read · Updated 2026-09-26

Poker has a lot of slang. These are the terms that come up most at a home game, grouped by topic. Each one lists the Chinese term players actually use, so mixed-language tables can understand each other.

## All terms

### The game

| Term | 中文 | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Texas Hold'em** (Hold'em, NLH) | 德州扑克 | The most popular poker game: two private cards each, five shared cards, best five-card hand wins. |
| **Omaha (PLO)** (Pot-Limit Omaha) | 奥马哈（PLO） | Like Hold'em but with four private cards; you must use exactly two of them plus exactly three from the board. Usually played pot-limit. |
| **Hand** | 一手牌 | Either one deal from shuffle to pot, or the five cards a player ends up with. Context tells you which. |
| **Hole cards** (pocket cards) | 手牌 | The cards dealt face down to you alone. |
| **Board** (community cards) | 公共牌 | The face-up shared cards in the middle that everyone can use. |
| **Preflop** | 翻牌前 | The first betting round, after hole cards are dealt and before any board cards. |
| **Flop** | 翻牌 | The first three board cards, dealt together, and the betting round that follows. |
| **Turn** | 转牌 | The fourth board card and its betting round. |
| **River** | 河牌 | The fifth and last board card and the final betting round. |
| **Pot** | 底池 | All chips put in during the current hand. The winner (or winners) take it. |
| **Side pot** | 边池 | A separate pot built from chips an all-in player can't match. Only players who put chips into it can win it. |
| **Main pot** | 主池 | The pot every player still in the hand, including the shortest all-in, can win. |
| **Showdown** | 摊牌 | After the last betting round, remaining players reveal their cards and the best hand wins. |
| **Split pot** (chop) | 平分底池 | Two or more players tie for the best hand and share the pot equally. |

### Actions

| Term | 中文 | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Check** | 过牌 | Pass the action without putting chips in. Only allowed when nobody has bet this round. |
| **Bet** | 下注 | Put the first chips into a betting round. |
| **Call** | 跟注 | Match the current bet to stay in the hand. |
| **Raise** | 加注 | Increase the current bet. Others must match the new amount to continue. |
| **3-bet** (re-raise) | 3-bet | The first re-raise. Preflop the big blind counts as the first bet, so the first raise is the 2-bet. |
| **Fold** | 弃牌 | Give up your cards and any claim to the pot. |
| **All-in** (shove) | 全下 | Put every chip you have in front of you into the pot. |
| **Limp** | 平跟 | Just call the big blind preflop instead of raising. |
| **Check-raise** | 过牌加注 | Check first, then raise after someone bets in the same round. |
| **Minimum raise** | 最小加注 | In no-limit and pot-limit, a raise must be at least as large as the previous bet or raise in that round. |
| **Muck** | 盖牌 | Throw your cards away face down, or the pile of discarded cards itself. |
| **String bet** | 分次下注 | Putting chips in with more than one forward motion without announcing first. Usually ruled a call. |

### Hands

| Term | 中文 | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Royal flush** | 皇家同花顺 | A-K-Q-J-10 all of one suit. The best possible hand. |
| **Straight flush** | 同花顺 | Five cards in a row, all of one suit. |
| **Four of a kind** (quads) | 四条 | Four cards of the same rank. |
| **Full house** (boat) | 葫芦 | Three of a kind plus a pair. |
| **Flush** | 同花 | Any five cards of one suit. |
| **Straight** | 顺子 | Five cards in a row of mixed suits. The ace can be high (10-J-Q-K-A) or low (A-2-3-4-5). |
| **Three of a kind** | 三条 | Three cards of the same rank. In Hold'em, a set or trips. |
| **Two pair** | 两对 | Two different pairs plus one other card. |
| **One pair** | 一对 | Two cards of the same rank plus three unrelated cards. |
| **High card** | 高牌 | No pair or better. The highest card decides, then the next, and so on. |
| **Kicker** | 踢脚 | A side card that breaks ties between hands of the same type, e.g. the K in A-A-K. |
| **Pocket pair** | 口袋对子 | Hole cards of the same rank, like 8♠ 8♥. |
| **Suited / offsuit** | 同花 / 杂色 | Hole cards of the same suit (written “s”, e.g. AKs) or of different suits (“o”, e.g. AKo). |
| **Suited connectors** | 同花连张 | Two consecutive cards of one suit, like 8♥ 7♥. |
| **Set** | 暗三 | Three of a kind made with a pocket pair plus one matching board card. |
| **Trips** | 明三 | Three of a kind made with one hole card plus a pair on the board. |
| **Top pair / overpair** | 顶对 / 超对 | Top pair: pairing the highest board card. Overpair: a pocket pair higher than every board card. |
| **The nuts** | 坚果牌 | The best possible hand given the current board. |

### Table & positions

| Term | 中文 | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Button** (dealer button, BTN) | 庄位 | The disc marking the nominal dealer. It moves one seat left every hand and acts last after the flop. |
| **Small blind** (SB) | 小盲 | The forced bet posted by the player directly left of the button, usually half the big blind. |
| **Big blind** (BB) | 大盲 | The larger forced bet, two seats left of the button. Sets the minimum bet for the hand. |
| **Ante** | 前注 | A small forced contribution before the deal. Paid by everyone, or all at once by the big blind (big blind ante). |
| **Straddle** | 抓头 | An optional blind, usually twice the big blind, posted before the deal by the player left of the big blind. They act last preflop. |
| **Bomb pot** | 炸弹底池 | A house-rule hand where everyone puts in an agreed amount, preflop betting is skipped and the flop is dealt straight away. |
| **Under the gun** (UTG) | 枪口位 | The seat left of the big blind, first to act preflop. |
| **Cutoff** (CO) | 关煞位 | The seat directly right of the button. |
| **Position** | 位置 | Where you act relative to others. Acting later (“in position”) means you see what others do first. |
| **Heads-up** | 单挑 | Only two players, either in a hand or left at the table. |
| **Burn card** | 烧牌 | The top card discarded face down before the flop, the turn and the river, so nobody gains from a marked or glimpsed card. |
| **Misdeal** | 误发 | A deal that has to be redone, e.g. the first or second card is exposed or someone got the wrong number of cards. |

### Odds & strategy

| Term | 中文 | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Outs** | 补牌 | Unseen cards that would improve your hand to one that is probably best. |
| **Draw** | 听牌 | A hand that isn't made yet but can become strong, like four cards to a flush. |
| **Open-ended / gutshot** | 两头顺 / 卡顺 | Straight draws: open-ended needs one of two ranks (8 outs), a gutshot needs one rank in the middle (4 outs). |
| **Pot odds** | 底池赔率 | The price of a call compared with what you can win: call ÷ (pot after your call). |
| **Equity** | 胜率 | Your share of the pot if all cards were dealt out from here — your chance to win, counting ties as half. |
| **Run it twice** | 发两次 | When players are all-in, deal the remaining board twice and split the pot between the two results. Needs everyone's agreement. |
| **Tilt** | 上头 | Playing worse because you are upset, usually after a bad beat. |
| **Bad beat** | 被反超 | Losing a hand you were a big favourite to win. |

### Tournaments

| Term | 中文 | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Blind level** | 盲注级别 | A fixed period in a tournament with set blinds; blinds rise at each new level. |
| **Freezeout** | 不可重购赛 | A tournament with no rebuys: once your chips are gone, you're out. |
| **Re-entry / add-on** | 重新参赛 / 加码 | Re-entry: buy back in with a fresh stack after busting, until a set level. Add-on: an optional extra stack at the end of that period. |
| **Colour up** | 换大码 | Swap the smallest chips for larger ones once the blinds no longer need them; odd leftovers go by a chip race. |
| **Bubble** | 泡沫 | The last finishing place before the places that get a share of the prizes. |

### Hosting & settling

| Term | 中文 | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Buy-in** | 买入 | The fixed chip stack a player takes when they sit down. In Poker Night each buy-in is one “Buy-in size” worth of chips. |
| **Rebuy** | 补码 | Taking another buy-in during the night. In Poker Night, tap + on the player's buy-ins. |
| **Stack** (chip count) | 筹码量 | The chips in front of a player right now. |
| **Cash game** (ring game) | 现金局 | A format where blinds stay fixed, players can come, go and rebuy, and chips keep the value set by the buy-in. |
| **Tournament** (MTT, sit-and-go) | 锦标赛 | Everyone starts with the same stack, blinds rise on a clock, and play goes on until one player has all the chips. |
| **House rules** | 房规 | The rules your group agrees on for things standard rules leave open: straddles, run it twice, rebuy limits and so on. |
| **Net** (P&L) | 净码 | In Poker Night: chips at the end minus buy-ins × buy-in size. Positive means up, negative means down. |
| **Balanced / Off by** | 账平 / 账不平 | Poker Night's check that every player's net adds up to zero. “Off by N” means the chip counts don't match what was bought in. |
| **Direct settle** | 直接互转 | Poker Night's default settle mode: players who are down pay players who are up directly, in as few transfers as possible. |
| **Banker** | 一人代收代付 | Poker Night's settle mode where one person collects from everyone who is down and pays everyone who is up. |
| **Charge** | 费用 | A shared cost such as food, a tip or chip rental, recorded in Poker Night and split among chosen players. |
| **Leave table** (cash out) | 下桌 | A player stops for the night. Poker Night records their final chips and keeps them in the balance check. |
| **Hit and run** | 赢了就走 | Leaving right after a big win. Allowed, but agree a leaving etiquette in advance so it doesn't sour the night. |
| **Slow roll** | 慢亮 | Deliberately taking your time to show a winning hand at showdown. The most disliked habit in poker. |
